     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocus
     7	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Restrict
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# The universal divisor rank-one open contract
    11	
    12	The genus divisor representer is unconditional, while the rank-one restriction still needs a
    13	family-level open-locus producer.  This file separates those two facts.  The predicate below is
    14	the inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` along the represented universal Abel map.  A
    15	`DivRankOneOpenData` witness identifies that predicate with the range of one actual open of the
    16	representer; only after that witness is supplied do we define the open subscheme.
    17	
    18	This shape prevents a logical `Subfunctor` from being silently reinterpreted as a scheme.  It also
    19	gives the canonical inverse lane a stable contract: it consumes the witness equality and can use
    20	the resulting open inclusion and all of its pullbacks without choosing a generator.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    25	
    26	universe u
    27	
    28	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    29	
    30	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    31	
    32	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    33	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    34	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    35	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    36	
    37	noncomputable section
    38	
    39	/-- The universal genus-divisor predicate whose Abel class lies in `PicRankOneOpen`. -/
    40	def divRankOneUniversalPredicate :
    41	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
    42	  divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi
    43	
    44	/-- Evaluation of the represented genus Abel map on a slice point, with the base morphism
    45	transported from the point in the divisor representer to its source. -/
    46	theorem abelDivAffGenusSigma_app_left_rankOne
    47	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    48	    (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
    49	    (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.left) q.left =
    50	      (⟨T.hom,
    51	        (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    52	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩ :
    53	        (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    54	          (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) := by
    55	  change (⟨q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom, _⟩ :
    56	      (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    57	        (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) =
    58	    ⟨T.hom,
    59	      (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    60	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩
    61	  refine Over.sigmaExtension_ext
    62	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) q.w ?_
    63	  let e : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶ T :=
    64	    Over.mkCongr q.w
    65	  let q' : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶
    66	      divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
    67	    Over.homMk q.left rfl
    68	  have hq : e ≫ q = q' := by
    69	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    70	    exact Category.id_comp _
    71	  change (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map e.op
    72	      ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    73	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)) =
    74	    (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app
    75	      (op (Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)))
    76	      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q')
    77	  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    78	    ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).naturality e.op)
    79	      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)
    80	  have hhom :
    81	      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q' =
    82	        (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).map e.op
    83	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q) := by
    84	    calc
    85	      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q' =
    86	          (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv (e ≫ q) := by
    87	            rw [hq]
    88	      _ = (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).map e.op
    89	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q) :=
    90	        (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv_comp e q
    91	  rw [hhom]
    92	  simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using hnat.symm
    93	
    94	/-- A represented genus divisor lies in the universal predicate exactly when its Abel image
    95	lifts through the single public rank-one Picard locus. -/
    96	theorem divRankOneUniversalPredicate_mem_iff_sigma
    97	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    98	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
    99	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   100	      ∃ v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
   101	          (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (op T.unop.left),
   102	        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op T.unop.left) v =
   103	          (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left := by
   104	  simp only [divRankOneUniversalPredicate,
   105	    divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter,
   106	    Subfunctor.preimage_obj, Set.mem_preimage]
   107	  let p := (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app T
   108	    ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv x)
   109	  change p ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔ _
   110	  have hleft :
   111	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left =
   112	        (⟨T.unop.hom, p⟩ :
   113	          (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
   114	            (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj
   115	              (op T.unop.left)) :=
   116	    abelDivAffGenusSigma_app_left_rankOne x
   117	  constructor
   118	  · intro hp
   119	    refine ⟨⟨T.unop.hom, ⟨p, hp⟩⟩, ?_⟩
   120	    rw [hleft]
   121	    rfl
   122	  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
   123	    rw [hleft] at hv
   124	    dsimp [picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   125	      CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat] at hv
   126	    rcases v with ⟨a, y⟩
   127	    dsimp at hv
   128	    have hfirst : a = T.unop.hom :=
   129	      congrArg (fun z => z.1) hv
   130	    cases hfirst
   131	    have hinj := Sigma.mk.inj hv
   132	    have heq :
   133	        ConcreteCategory.hom
   134	            ((PicRankOneOpen pi).ι.app
   135	              (op (Over.mk T.unop.hom))) y = p :=
   136	      eq_of_heq hinj.2
   137	    change p ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T
   138	    rw [← heq]
   139	    exact y.property
   140	
   141	/-- The Yoneda map induced by the inclusion of an open of an object in the slice.  Naming this
   142	map is useful to consumers which need the actual factorisation through the open, rather than only
   143	the proposition that a point lies in its range. -/
   144	def openSubfunctorMap (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
   145	    yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) ⟶ yoneda.obj D :=
   146	  yoneda.map (Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) U.ι)
   147	
   148	/-- The subfunctor represented by an open `U` of an object `D` in the slice over `Spec k`.
   149	
   150	Its values are precisely morphisms which factor through the open immersion `U.ι`; using the
   151	Yoneda range keeps this definition independent of any chosen affine presentation of `U`. -/
   152	def openSubfunctor (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
   153	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj D) :=
   154	  Subfunctor.range (openSubfunctorMap D U)
   155	
   156	/-- Unpack range membership into the actual source point and its equality in the ambient Yoneda
   157	functor.  This is the pointwise factorisation API used by inverse constructions. -/
   158	theorem openSubfunctor_mem_iff
   159	    (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens)
   160	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   161	    (x : (yoneda.obj D).obj T) :
   162	    x ∈ (openSubfunctor D U).obj T ↔
   163	      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom))).obj T,
   164	        (openSubfunctorMap D U).app T y = x := by
   165	  rfl
   166	
   167	/-- An explicit geometric certificate for the universal rank-one predicate.
   168	
   169	The equality is the missing family-level producer/gluing statement: it identifies the logical
   170	preimage with an actual open of the canonical genus representer.  No default or top-open witness
   171	is manufactured here. -/
   172	structure DivRankOneOpenData (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi] where
   173	  carrier : (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens
   174	  carrier_eq :
   175	    openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) carrier =
   176	      divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi
   177	
   178	/-- Genuine relative openness of the public Picard rank-one locus produces the universal
   179	divisor rank-one open.  The carrier is the open image of the represented pullback of the Abel
   180	map, and the proof below identifies its Yoneda range with the defining predicate. -/
   181	theorem divRankOneOpenData_of_picRankOneOpen_isOpen
   182	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) :
   183	    Nonempty (DivRankOneOpenData pi) := by
   184	  obtain ⟨X, snd, fst, hpb⟩ := h.rep (abelDivAffGenusSigma C)
   185	  letI : IsOpenImmersion snd :=
   186	    h.property (abelDivAffGenusSigma C) fst snd hpb
   187	  let U := snd.opensRange
   188	  refine ⟨⟨U, ?_⟩⟩
   189	  ext T x
   190	  rw [openSubfunctor_mem_iff]
   191	  rw [divRankOneUniversalPredicate_mem_iff_sigma]
   192	  have hpbT := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op T.unop.left)
   193	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hpbT
   194	  constructor
   195	  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
   196	    have hxy : x.left = y.left ≫ U.ι := by
   197	      have hleft := congrArg Over.Hom.left hy
   198	      exact hleft.symm
   199	    have hrange : Set.range x.left.base ⊆ Set.range snd.base := by
   200	      rw [← Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange snd]
   201	      rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
   202	      rw [hxy, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
   203	      change U.ι.base (y.left.base t) ∈ snd.opensRange
   204	      change U.ι.base (y.left.base t) ∈ U
   205	      exact (y.left.base t).property
   206	    let u : T.unop.left ⟶ X :=
   207	      IsOpenImmersion.lift snd x.left hrange
   208	    have hu : u ≫ snd = x.left :=
   209	      IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
   210	    refine ⟨fst.app (op T.unop.left) u, ?_⟩
   211	    have hcomm := congrArg
   212	      (fun f => (ConcreteCategory.hom f) u) hpbT.1
   213	    change (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op T.unop.left)
   214	        (fst.app (op T.unop.left) u) =
   215	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) (u ≫ snd) at hcomm
   216	    simpa only [hu] using hcomm
   217	  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
   218	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := hpbT.2.2 v x.left hv
   219	    change u ≫ snd = x.left at hu₂
   220	    have hrange : Set.range x.left.base ⊆ Set.range U.ι.base := by
   221	      rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
   222	      change Set.range x.left.base ⊆ snd.opensRange
   223	      rw [Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange]
   224	      rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
   225	      refine ⟨u.base t, ?_⟩
   226	      have happ := congrArg (fun f => f.base t) hu₂
   227	      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using happ
   228	    let V : Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
   229	      Over.mk (U.ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)
   230	    let j : V ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
   231	      Over.homMk (U := V) U.ι
   232	    let e : U.toScheme = V.left := rfl
   233	    let l : T.unop.left ⟶ U.toScheme :=
   234	      IsOpenImmersion.lift U.ι x.left hrange
   235	    let l' : T.unop.left ⟶ V.left := l ≫ eqToHom e
   236	    have he : eqToHom e ≫ j.left = U.ι := by
   237	      subst e
   238	      rfl
   239	    have hl : l' ≫ j.left = x.left := by
   240	      dsimp only [l']
   241	      rw [Category.assoc, he]
   242	      dsimp only [l]
   243	      exact IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
   244	    have hlw : l' ≫ V.hom = T.unop.hom := by
   245	      rw [← j.w, ← Category.assoc, hl]
   246	      exact x.w
   247	    let y : (yoneda.obj V).obj T := Over.homMk l' hlw
   248	    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
   249	    change y ≫ j = x
   250	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
   251	    exact hl
   252	
   253	/-- A named carrier choice for consumers which already possess the Picard openness theorem. -/
   254	def divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen
   255	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) : DivRankOneOpenData pi :=
   256	  Classical.choice (divRankOneOpenData_of_picRankOneOpen_isOpen pi h)
   257	
   258	/-- The open subscheme supplied by a `DivRankOneOpenData` witness. -/
   259	def DivRankOneOpen (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) : Scheme :=
   260	  h.carrier.toScheme
   261	
   262	/-- The canonical open immersion into the genus divisor representer. -/
   263	def divRankOneOpenMap (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   264	    DivRankOneOpen pi h ⟶ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left :=
   265	  h.carrier.ι
   266	
   267	theorem divRankOneOpen_isOpenImmersion
   268	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   269	    IsOpenImmersion (divRankOneOpenMap pi h) := by
   270	  change IsOpenImmersion h.carrier.ι
   271	  infer_instance
   272	
   273	/- The scheme-level certificate also has the presheaf form consumed by relative-open inverse
   274	   constructions.  This is conditional only on the explicit carrier witness above. -/
   275	theorem divRankOneOpenMap_presheaf_isOpenImmersion
   276	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   277	    IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (yoneda.map (divRankOneOpenMap pi h)) := by
   278	  exact MorphismProperty.relative_map (divRankOneOpen_isOpenImmersion pi h)
   279	
   280	/-- The open represented object, retained in the slice over `Spec k` for consumers of the affine
   281	divisor functor. -/
   282	def divRankOneOpenOver (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   283	    Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
   284	  Over.mk (divRankOneOpenMap pi h ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)
   285	
   286	/-- The inclusion of the certified open, as a morphism in the slice over `Spec k`.
   287	
   288	This is the map whose Yoneda action is consumed by the canonical rank-one Abel inverse.  Naming
   289	it separately keeps consumers independent of the implementation spelling of `divRankOneOpenOver`.
   290	-/
   291	def divRankOneOpenOverMap (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   292	    divRankOneOpenOver pi h ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
   293	  Over.homMk (divRankOneOpenMap pi h)
   294	
   295	/-- Pull back the certified rank-one open along an arbitrary slice morphism. -/
   296	def divRankOneOpenPullback
   297	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   298	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) : T.left.Opens :=
   299	  q.left ⁻¹ᵁ h.carrier
   300	
   301	theorem divRankOneOpenPullback_isOpenImmersion
   302	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   303	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
   304	    IsOpenImmersion (divRankOneOpenPullback pi h q).ι := by
   305	  infer_instance
   306	
   307	/-- The arbitrary slice pullback remains an open immersion after passing to Yoneda. -/
   308	theorem divRankOneOpenPullbackMap_presheaf_isOpenImmersion
   309	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   310	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
   311	    IsOpenImmersion.presheaf
   312	      (yoneda.map (divRankOneOpenPullback pi h q).ι) := by
   313	  exact MorphismProperty.relative_map (divRankOneOpenPullback_isOpenImmersion pi h q)
   314	
   315	/-- Pointwise form of arbitrary base-change compatibility for the certified open. -/
   316	theorem mem_divRankOneOpenPullback_iff
   317	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   318	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C)
   319	    (x : T.left) :
   320	    x ∈ divRankOneOpenPullback pi h q ↔ q.left.base x ∈ h.carrier := by
   321	  rfl
   322	
   323	/-- The universal predicate is exactly the represented preimage used by the Abel restriction. -/
   324	theorem divRankOneUniversalPredicate_eq_preimage :
   325	    divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi = divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi :=
   326	  rfl
   327	
   328	/-- The certified open carrier has the universal rank-one predicate as its Yoneda range. -/
   329	theorem divRankOneOpen_carrier_eq
   330	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   331	    openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier =
   332	      divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi :=
   333	  h.carrier_eq
   334	
   335	/-- Pointwise form of the witness equality, exposing the exact contract consumed by an inverse.
   336	
   337	The right-hand side is the range of the open immersion, so a consumer can use this theorem to
   338	replace a rank-one predicate proof by a factorisation through `DivRankOneOpen pi h`. -/
   339	theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_iff
   340	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   341	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   342	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
   343	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   344	      x ∈ (openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier).obj T := by
   345	  rw [h.carrier_eq]
   346	
   347	/-- A point of the universal rank-one predicate factors through the certified open immersion.
   348	
   349	Unlike a bare range-membership proof, the conclusion exposes the source point and the equality
   350	of its image with the given divisor point, which is the exact data needed by a canonical inverse. -/
   351	theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_iff_factorization
   352	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   353	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   354	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
   355	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   356	      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (Over.mk
   357	          (h.carrier.ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom))).obj T,
   358	        (openSubfunctorMap (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier).app T y = x := by
   359	  rw [divRankOneOpen_mem_iff pi h x, openSubfunctor_mem_iff]
   360	
   361	/-- The same factorisation contract with the named open object and slice inclusion.
   362	
   363	The source in the preceding theorem is definitionally the slice object
   364	`divRankOneOpenOver pi h`; this corollary gives the stable public names expected by inverse
   365	consumers. -/
   366	theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_iff_factorization_over
   367	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   368	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   369	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
   370	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   371	      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (divRankOneOpenOver pi h)).obj T,
   372	        (yoneda.map (divRankOneOpenOverMap pi h)).app T y = x := by
   373	  rw [divRankOneOpen_mem_iff_factorization pi h x]
   374	  rfl
   375	
   376	/-- The exact inverse-facing factorisation for a point of the represented rank-one preimage.
   377	
   378	The source point is retained as a subtype, so its membership proof is tied to the same divisor
   379	that is factored through `DivRankOneOpenOver`; no unrelated class or top-open witness can satisfy
   380	this endpoint. -/
   381	theorem rankOneRepresenterRestriction_factorization
   382	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   383	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   384	    (x : (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).obj T) :
   385	    ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (divRankOneOpenOver pi h)).obj T,
   386	      (yoneda.map (divRankOneOpenOverMap pi h)).app T y = x.1 := by
   387	  apply (divRankOneOpen_mem_iff_factorization_over pi h x.1).mp
   388	  exact x.2
   389	
   390	/-- Immediate inverse-facing consumer of Picard rank-one openness: every point of the represented
   391	rank-one divisor preimage factors through the open carrier extracted from that certificate. -/
   392	theorem rankOneRepresenterRestriction_factorization_of_picRankOneOpen_isOpen
   393	    (hPic : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi)
   394	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   395	    (x : (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).obj T) :
   396	    ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (divRankOneOpenOver pi
   397	        (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen pi hPic))).obj T,
   398	      (yoneda.map (divRankOneOpenOverMap pi
   399	        (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen pi hPic))).app T y = x.1 :=
   400	  rankOneRepresenterRestriction_factorization pi
   401	    (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen pi hPic) x
   402	
   403	/-- A point in the certified open carrier is a point of the universal rank-one predicate. -/
   404	theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_of_carrier
   405	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   406	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   407	    {x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T}
   408	    (hx : x ∈ (openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier).obj T) :
   409	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T := by
   410	  exact (divRankOneOpen_mem_iff pi h x).mpr hx
   411	
   412	/- The logical rank-one predicate remains stable under arbitrary pullback, independently of the
   413	   geometric witness used to represent it by an open. -/
   414	theorem divRankOneOpen_baseChange_mem
   415	    {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   416	    (f : T ⟶ T')
   417	    {x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T}
   418	    (hx : x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T) :
   419	    (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).map f x ∈
   420	      (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T' :=
   421	  (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).map f hx
   422	
   423	end
   424	
   425	end AlgebraicGeometry

    11	# The widened divisor representer at the Picard atlas seam
    12	
    13	The widened divisor functor of a challenge curve is represented at the genus parameter.  This
    14	module inserts that representation into the Abel construction and then into the Zariski-local
    15	representability theorem for the degree-zero Picard functor.
    16	
    17	The resulting chart family has no assumed divisor representation.  Its remaining inputs are the
    18	two geometric conditions of the local-representability theorem: every restricted Abel map is a
    19	representable open immersion, and the restricted maps cover the Picard sheaf pointwise.
    20	
    21	This is not an unconditional Picard representability result: the final declaration below retains
    22	both geometric inputs.  Moreover, at the larger admissible coverage parameter the raw Abel map has
    23	positive-dimensional linear-system fibres in positive genus, so the larger divisor representer
    24	cannot simply be substituted as an open chart source.  The remaining datum-tail construction is
    25	the corrected Altman--Kleiman step: represent the quotient by equality of the induced Picard class,
    26	thereby removing those fibres before applying the Picard representability seam.
    27	
    28	## Main declarations
    29	
    30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.abelSigmaChartAffGenus` is the widened Abel chart formed from the chosen
    31	  genus-parameter divisor representer.
    32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.universalDivFamAffGenus` is its universal widened divisor family.
    33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible` is the no-argument widened Abel map at the
    34	  unconditional admissible coverage parameter; its legal chart index is chosen internally.
    35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.universalDivFamAffAdmissible` is the corresponding universal family.
    36	* `AlgebraicGeometry.affineGenusChart` restricts a multi-index family of these maps to chosen
    37	  source opens.
    38	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0RepresentableByOfAffineGenusCharts` is the conditional final assembly
    39	  once the restricted charts are open immersions and cover pointwise.
    40	-/

    62	/-- Pulling back the chosen universal family gives the widened family classified by the

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocalDivisor

/-!
# Affine evaluation-divisor coherence for the FibrePresented producer

The arbitrary-scheme `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` producer needs a divisor cut by the
canonical evaluation section which is stable under restriction of affine test schemes.  This
file records two construction-level inputs for that gluing step:

* `datumSectionBaseChange_tower` proves that the tied datum section itself is coherent along
  every affine coefficient tower;
* `baseOpenRankOneDivisor_mul_eq` proves independence of the chosen rank-one generator after
  passing to a pairwise product open.

The remaining gluing edge is deliberately explicit: one must identify `DivFamZarAff.mapAlg` of
the local divisor with the divisor cut by the tower-transported section.  No
`PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` or pullback-square hypothesis is introduced here.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
open scoped TensorProduct

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
variable {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}

namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation

/-- The actual section attached to a tied presentation is transitive under arbitrary affine
coefficient extension.  The cast is along the canonical equality between iterated and direct
base change of the same cocycle datum. -/
theorem datumSectionBaseChange_tower
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B]
    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B']
    [Algebra B B'] [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B'] [IsScalarTower k B B']
    [IsScalarTower P.cover.Carrier B B']
    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
    let hD : (P.datum.baseChange B).baseChange B' = P.datum.baseChange B' :=
      P.datum.baseChange_baseChange C P.cover.Carrier B B'
    cast (congrArg (fun E : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B' pi =>
      ↑(gluedSubmodule B' E.pieces E.unit ⊤)) hD)
        ((P.datum.baseChange B).sectionsMapTop B'
          (P.datumSectionBaseChange B y)) =
      P.datumSectionBaseChange B' y := by
  rw [P.datumSectionBaseChange_one_tmul B y,
    P.datumSectionBaseChange_one_tmul B' y]
  exact P.datum.sectionsMapTop_tower
    C P.cover.Carrier B B' (P.datumSection y)

/-- A generator which is fibrewise nonzero on `D(f)` remains so on `D(f * g)`. -/
theorem generator_nonzero_on_mul_left
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    (f g : P.cover.Carrier)
    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f * g ∉ p.asIdeal →
      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0 := by
  intro p hfg
  exact hy p fun hf => hfg (p.asIdeal.mul_mem_right g hf)

/-- A generator which is fibrewise nonzero on `D(g)` remains so on `D(f * g)`. -/
theorem generator_nonzero_on_mul_right
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    (f g : P.cover.Carrier)
    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, g ∉ p.asIdeal →
      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f * g ∉ p.asIdeal →

    13	
    14	`rankOneDivisorUniqueness` (`Pic0RankOneUniquenessDischarge.lean`) settles, over every affine
    15	test whose plus class lies in the rank-one locus, that at most one widened locally certified
    16	divisor class of degree `genus C` has a prescribed Abel value.  This file upgrades that affine
    17	statement into the second inverse law of the rank-one Abel/evaluation pair on the big site: every
    18	`E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi` automatically satisfies `E.AbelInverse`, so its
    19	`evaluationIso` is available with no extra hypothesis.
    20	
    21	The upgrade is genuinely local-to-global on the base, and it reuses only landed material:
    22	
    23	* **The vehicle collapse along an affine open** (`divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_map_fromSpecAffine`):
    24	  restricting a widened vehicle section along `Over.fromSpecAffine T U` and collapsing through the
    25	  affine comparison recovers the section's value at the affine open `U`.  This is the `mapVal`
    26	  no-gluing computation followed by the `Spec`-`Γ` bookkeeping identity
    27	  `fromSpecAffine_ΓTop_comp_appLEAlgHom`.
    28	* **Arbitrary-test uniqueness** (`divFamZarAff_eq_of_rankOne`): two widened vehicle sections over
    29	  an arbitrary test whose Abel values agree, one of whose Abel classes lies in the rank-one locus,
    30	  are equal.  Two sections of the widened vehicle agree iff they agree on affine opens
    31	  (`divFamZarAff.ext`); on each affine open the pulled-back rank-one class (via
    32	  `picRankOneOpen_map_mem` along `Over.fromSpecAffine T U`) feeds the affine

    34	  `picEtMap_abelDivAff'`, `picEtAffineEquiv_abelDivAff'`, and the vehicle collapse above.

    36	  uniqueness gives injectivity of the represented Abel map on every slice object, and the
    37	  `Σ`-extension preserves it componentwise.

   117	/-- The represented Abel map is injective on every slice object: this is arbitrary-test

   149	theorem rankOneAbelSigma_app_injective (Y : Schemeᵒᵖ) :

   163	namespace PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData
   164	
   165	/-- **The Abel inverse law holds automatically**: every canonical evaluation-divisor classifier
   166	of the rank-one locus is a two-sided inverse of the restricted Abel map.  From the right inverse
   167	`E.divisor_abel` and injectivity of `rankOneAbelSigma pi`, the left inverse follows by
   168	cancellation. -/
   169	theorem abelInverse_of_uniqueness (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) :
   170	    E.AbelInverse := by
   171	  have h : rankOneAbelSigma pi ≫ E.divisor
   172	      = 𝟙 (rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)) := by
   173	    ext Y d
   174	    change E.divisor.app Y ((rankOneAbelSigma pi).app Y d) = d
   175	    apply rankOneAbelSigma_app_injective pi Y
   176	    exact E.divisor_abel_app pi Y.unop ((rankOneAbelSigma pi).app Y d)
   177	  exact h
   178	
   179	/-- The rank-one family isomorphism, with the Abel inverse discharged: the restricted Abel map
   180	and the canonical evaluation divisor are mutually inverse on the big site. -/
   181	noncomputable def rankOneAbelIso (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) :
   182	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ≅ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
   183	  E.evaluationIso pi (E.abelInverse_of_uniqueness pi)

    12	/-!
    13	# Faithfully-flat descent for the widened divisor functor, via representability
    14	
    15	The widened divisor functor `divFunctorAff C (genus C)` is representable
    16	(`divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy`, `Picard/DivRepAffChallenge.lean`), and over an affine
    17	test the functor value collapses to `DivFamZarAff` (`divFamZarAffAffineEquiv`,
    18	`Picard/DivisorFamilyAffVehicle.lean`).  Composing the two turns a widened class over a test
    19	algebra into a **classifying morphism** to the representing scheme, naturally in the algebra
    20	(`divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_naturality`, `Picard/DivisorFamilyAffMap.lean`).
    21	
    22	This file cashes that in for descent: `Spec` of a faithfully flat ring map is quasi-compact,
    23	surjective and flat, hence an **effective epimorphism** of schemes by the fpqc-subcanonicity
    24	instance (`Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/Fpqc.lean`).  Precomposition with an (effective) epi
    25	is injective, so the widened divisor presheaf is *separated* along faithfully flat maps; and a
    26	class over the carrier of an étale cover whose two coprojection pullbacks to the tensor square
    27	agree has classifying morphism coequalizing the kernel pair of the cover (through
    28	`pullbackSpecIso`), so it *descends*, uniquely, to the base ring.
    29	
    30	## Main declarations
    31	
    32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZarAff.classify` — the classifying equivalence
    33	  `DivFamZarAff C S (genus C) ≃ (overSpec k S ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C)`, with naturality
    34	  `DivFamZarAff.classify_mapAlgHom`.
    35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.effectiveEpi_specMap_of_faithfullyFlat` — `Spec` of a faithfully flat
    36	  algebra map is an effective epimorphism.
    37	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_injective_of_faithfullyFlat` — the
    38	  separated-presheaf property of the widened carrier along faithfully flat maps.
    39	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZarAff.exists_descent_of_tensor_eq` — effective-epi descent of a
    40	  widened divisor class along an étale cover of the test algebra.
    41	-/

    60	/-- **The classifying equivalence of the widened divisor functor at an affine test**: a widened

    64	noncomputable def DivFamZarAff.classify (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] :
    65	    DivFamZarAff C S (genus C) ≃ (overSpec k S ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :=

    69	/-- **Naturality of the classifying equivalence** along a `k`-algebra map of affine tests: the

    73	theorem DivFamZarAff.classify_mapAlgHom {S S' : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
    74	    [CommRing S'] [Algebra k S'] (φ : S →ₐ[k] S') (F : DivFamZarAff C S (genus C)) :

     8	/-!
     9	# Functoriality of the WIDENED vehicle along an arbitrary test morphism (R2, residue (b))
    10	
    11	The widened vehicle `divFamZarAff` (`…AffVehicle.lean`) is functorial along an **arbitrary**
    12	morphism `f : T' ⟶ T` of test objects: the value of the restricted family at an affine open
    13	`W ⊆ T'.left` — whose `f`-image need not lie in any affine open of `T.left` — is *glued* over a
    14	finite basic-open refinement of `W` subordinate to the preimages of affine opens, using the
    15	widened S5b Zariski keystones through the basic-open toolkit (`…AffMapKit.lean`).
    16	
    17	This is the last packaging layer of R2 residue (b): with it the widened carrier of protection
    18	I-0492 is a functor on the whole slice over `Spec k`, which is the generality every DD-R
    19	consumer (`DivRepGlobalData.pull_comp`) is stated at.
    20	
    21	## Main declarations
    22	
    23	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarAff.IsPullbackValue` — the characterizing property of the glued
    24	  value, with `pullbackValue_unique` (Zariski separation) and `exists_isPullbackValue`
    25	  (Zariski gluing).
    26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarAff.map C n f : divFamZarAff C n T → divFamZarAff C n T'`, with
    27	  `map_id`, `map_comp`, and the no-gluing evaluation `mapVal_eq_mapAlgHom`.
    28	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_naturality` — over affine tests, `map` along
    29	  `Spec` of an algebra map is `DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom` of that map under the widened affine
    30	  collapse.
    31	
    32	## What is and is not asserted
    33	
    34	Everything here is about the Zariski topology of the **base**.  R2 widened the curve side, so
    35	these are the chart-typed proofs of `DivisorFamilyZarMap.lean` with `DivFamZar` replaced by
    36	`DivFamZarAff` — no new geometry, and in particular **no `|P¹(k)|` hypothesis** anywhere in the
    37	statements or their route.  What the widened lane still owes is unchanged by this file: the
    38	subordinate Stacks 0B8B input (residue (a), out of scope per I-0492 clause 2).
    39	-/

    67	/-- The characterizing property of the value at `W` of the restriction of `s` along `f`: on
    68	every affine sub-open of `W` contained in the preimage of an affine open `V` of the target, it
    69	restricts to the base change of the value of `s` at `V`. -/
    70	def IsPullbackValue (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T) (W : T'.left.affineOpens)
    71	    (v : DivFamZarAff C Γ(T'.left, W.1) n) : Prop :=
    72	  ∀ (W₀ : T'.left.affineOpens) (hW₀ : W₀.1 ≤ W.1) (V : T.left.affineOpens)
    73	    (hV : W₀.1 ≤ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1),
    74	    DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T' hW₀) v
    75	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W₀.1 hV) (s.1 V)

    78	`DivFamZarAff` over a basic refinement subordinate to the preimages of affine opens. -/
    79	theorem pullbackValue_unique {f : T' ⟶ T} {s : divFamZarAff C n T}

    86	    (fun w _ => by

    88	        T.left.isBasis_affineOpens (show f.left.base w ∈ (⊤ : T.left.Opens) from trivial)

    92	  rw [hv ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r⟩ (T'.left.basicOpen_le r) V hle,
    93	    hv' ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r⟩ (T'.left.basicOpen_le r) V hle]

    98	/-- **Existence of the glued value**: the restriction of a compatible family of widened classes
    99	along an arbitrary morphism of test objects has a value at every affine open of the source,
   100	glued over a finite basic-open refinement subordinate to the preimages of affine opens — the

   105	  -- the basic refinement subordinate to preimages of affine opens

   107	    (fun U₀ => ∃ V : T.left.affineOpens, U₀ = f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
   108	    (fun w _ => by
   109	      obtain ⟨V, hVaff, hfwV, -⟩ := Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp

   112	  have hsub' : ∀ r ∈ sub, ∃ V : T.left.affineOpens,
   113	      T'.left.basicOpen r ≤ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := fun r hr => by
   114	    obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨V, rfl⟩, hle⟩ := hsub r hr
   115	    exact ⟨V, hle⟩
   116	  choose Vc hVc using hsub'
   117	  have hbmul : ∀ r r' : ↥sub,
   118	      T'.left.basicOpen ((r : Γ(T'.left, W.1)) * (r' : Γ(T'.left, W.1)))

   120	    rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
   121	    exact inf_le_left
   122	  have hbmul' : ∀ r r' : ↥sub,
   123	      T'.left.basicOpen ((r : Γ(T'.left, W.1)) * (r' : Γ(T'.left, W.1)))
   124	        ≤ T'.left.basicOpen (r' : Γ(T'.left, W.1)) := fun r r' => by
   125	    rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
   126	    exact inf_le_right

   129	    (fun r : ↥sub => DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
   130	      (Over.appLEAlgHom f (Vc r.1 r.2).1 (T'.left.basicOpen r.1) (hVc r.1 r.2))
   131	      (s.1 (Vc r.1 r.2)))
   132	    hbmul hbmul'
   133	    (fun r r' => by
   134	      -- the overlap compatibility, from choice independence
   135	      rw [← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp, ← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp,
   136	        Over.resAlgHom_comp_appLEAlgHom, Over.resAlgHom_comp_appLEAlgHom]
   137	      exact mapAlgHom_appLE_eq C n f s (W₀ := ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen (r.1 * r'.1)⟩) _ _)

   140	  obtain ⟨sub₀, hspan₀, hsub₀⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover W₀.2
   141	    (fun U₀ => ∃ r ∈ sub, U₀ = T'.left.basicOpen r)
   142	    (fun w hw => by
   143	      have hwW : w ∈ (⨆ r ∈ (↑sub : Set Γ(T'.left, W.1)), T'.left.basicOpen r) := by
   144	        rw [iSup_basicOpen_of_span_eq_top _ _ hspan]

   153	        (Over.resAlgHom T' (T'.left.basicOpen_le r)) z

   171	
   172	/-- Existence and uniqueness of the glued value. -/
   173	theorem existsUnique_isPullbackValue (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T)
   174	    (W : T'.left.affineOpens) : ∃! v, IsPullbackValue C n f s W v := by
   175	  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_isPullbackValue f s W
   176	  exact ⟨v, hv, fun v' hv' => pullbackValue_unique hv' hv⟩
   177	
   178	/-! ## The functoriality -/
   179	
   180	variable (C n)
   181	
   182	/-- The value of the restricted widened family at an affine open of the source. -/
   183	noncomputable def mapVal (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T)
   184	    (W : T'.left.affineOpens) : DivFamZarAff C Γ(T'.left, W.1) n :=
   185	  (existsUnique_isPullbackValue f s W).choose
   186	
   187	lemma mapVal_spec (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T) (W : T'.left.affineOpens) :
   188	    IsPullbackValue C n f s W (mapVal C n f s W) :=
   189	  (existsUnique_isPullbackValue f s W).choose_spec.1
   190	
   191	lemma mapVal_eq_of (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T) {W : T'.left.affineOpens}
   192	    {v : DivFamZarAff C Γ(T'.left, W.1) n} (hv : IsPullbackValue C n f s W v) :
   193	    mapVal C n f s W = v :=
   194	  pullbackValue_unique (mapVal_spec C n f s W) hv
   195	
   196	/-- The value of the restricted widened family on an affine open lying in the preimage of an
   197	affine open is the plain base change — no gluing. -/
   198	lemma mapVal_eq_mapAlgHom (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T)
   199	    {W : T'.left.affineOpens} {V : T.left.affineOpens} (hV : W.1 ≤ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) :
   200	    mapVal C n f s W

   202	  have h := mapVal_spec C n f s W W le_rfl V hV

   204

   206	last packaging layer of R2 residue (b): the value at each affine open of the source is the
   207	glued pullback value. -/

   209	  fun s =>
   210	    ⟨fun W => mapVal C n f s W, by
   211	      intro U V h
   212	      beta_reduce
   213	      refine (mapVal_eq_of C n f s (W := U) ?_).symm
   214	      intro W₀ hW₀ V' hV'
   215	      rw [← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp, Over.resAlgHom_comp]
   216	      exact mapVal_spec C n f s V W₀ (hW₀.trans h) V' hV'⟩
   217	
   218	@[simp]
   219	lemma map_val (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T) (W : T'.left.affineOpens) :
   220	    (map C n f s).1 W = mapVal C n f s W :=
   221	  rfl
   222	
   223	/-- The functor law: restriction along the identity is the identity. -/
   224	theorem map_id (s : divFamZarAff C n T) : map C n (𝟙 T) s = s := by
   225	  refine ext fun W => ?_
   226	  rw [map_val]
   227	  refine mapVal_eq_of C n (𝟙 T) s ?_
   228	  intro W₀ hW₀ V hV
   229	  have hV' : W₀.1 ≤ V.1 := by
   230	    intro p hp
   231	    have hmem := hV hp
   232	    rw [Over.id_left] at hmem
   233	    exact hmem
   234	  rw [Over.appLEAlgHom_id T V.1 W₀.1 hV hV', s.compat W₀ W hW₀, s.compat W₀ V hV']
   235	
   236	/-- The functor law: restriction along a composite is the composite of the restrictions. -/
   237	theorem map_comp (f : T' ⟶ T) (g : T'' ⟶ T') (s : divFamZarAff C n T) :
   238	    map C n (g ≫ f) s = map C n g (map C n f s) := by
   239	  classical
   240	  refine ext fun W => ?_
   241	  rw [map_val, map_val]
   242	  refine (mapVal_eq_of C n (g ≫ f) s ?_)
   243	  intro W₀ hW₀ V hV
   244	  -- refine by basic opens whose `g`-image lies in an affine open inside `f⁻¹ V`
   245	  obtain ⟨sub, hspan, hsub⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover W₀.2
   246	    (fun U₀ => ∃ V'' : T'.left.affineOpens,
   247	      V''.1 ≤ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 ∧ U₀ = g.left ⁻¹ᵁ V''.1)
   248	    (fun w hw => by
   249	      have hgw : g.left.base w ∈ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := by
   250	        have := hV hw
   251	        rw [Over.comp_left] at this
   252	        exact this
   253	      obtain ⟨V'', hV''aff, hgwV'', hV''le⟩ := Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp
   254	        T'.left.isBasis_affineOpens hgw
   255	      exact ⟨g.left ⁻¹ᵁ V'', hgwV'', ⟨⟨V'', hV''aff⟩, hV''le, rfl⟩⟩)
   256	  refine eq_of_basic_eq W₀ sub hspan (fun q hq => ?_)
   257	  obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨V'', hV''le, rfl⟩, hqle⟩ := hsub q hq
   258	  -- the left side, through the two glued values
   259	  have hL : DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T'' (T''.left.basicOpen_le q))
   260	      (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T'' hW₀)
   261	        (mapVal C n g (map C n f s) W))
   262	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.appLEAlgHom g V''.1 (T''.left.basicOpen q) hqle)
   263	          (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 V''.1 hV''le) (s.1 V)) := by
   264	    rw [← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp, Over.resAlgHom_comp,
   265	      mapVal_spec C n g (map C n f s) W ⟨_, W₀.2.basicOpen q⟩
   266	        ((T''.left.basicOpen_le q).trans hW₀) V'' hqle,
   267	      map_val, mapVal_eq_mapAlgHom C n f s hV''le]
   268	  rw [hL, ← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp, ← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp,
   269	    Over.appLEAlgHom_comp f g V.1 V''.1 (T''.left.basicOpen q) hV''le hqle
   270	      (hqle.trans ((g.left.preimage_mono hV''le).trans
   271	        (le_of_eq (by rw [Over.comp_left, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage])))),

   277	
   278	section Functor
   279

   281	lived inside `namespace divFamZarAff` and ended with it.  Without re-declaring them here,
   282	`divFunctorAff` takes them implicitly and the `simp` lemmas below — which apply it to `C` and
   283	`n` — do not elaborate. -/
   284	variable (C n)

   286	/-- **The widened divisor functor**: the R2 carrier of protection I-0492 as a presheaf of types
   287	on the slice over `Spec k`, with the glued restriction `divFamZarAff.map` along arbitrary test

   289	generality `DivRepGlobalData.pull_comp` consumes. -/

   291	  obj T := divFamZarAff C n T.unop
   292	  map g := ↾divFamZarAff.map C n g.unop
   293	  map_id T := by
   294	    ext s U
   295	    exact congrArg (fun z : divFamZarAff C n T.unop => z.1 U) (divFamZarAff.map_id C n s)
   296	  map_comp {T T' T''} g h := by
   297	    ext s U
   298	    exact congrArg (fun z : divFamZarAff C n T''.unop => z.1 U)
   299	      (divFamZarAff.map_comp C n g.unop h.unop s)
   300	
   301	@[simp]
   302	lemma divFunctorAff_obj (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) :
   303	    (divFunctorAff C n).obj T = divFamZarAff C n T.unop :=
   304	  rfl
   305	
   306	@[simp]
   307	lemma divFunctorAff_map {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ} (g : T ⟶ T')
   308	    (s : divFamZarAff C n T.unop) :
   309	    (divFunctorAff C n).map g s = divFamZarAff.map C n g.unop s :=
   310	  rfl
   311	
   312	end Functor
   313	
   314	/-! ## Naturality of the widened affine comparison -/
   315	
   316	section AffineNaturality
   317	
   318	variable {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
   319	
   320	/-- The widened affine comparison intertwines the section-ring pullback along `Spec` of an
   321	algebra map with the algebra map itself (local copy of the `PicEtMap` helper). -/
   322	private lemma overSpecΓTop_appLE_comp_aff (φ : A →ₐ[k] B) :
   323	    (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k B).toAlgHom.comp
   324	      (Over.appLEAlgHom (Over.overSpecMap φ) (overSpecTopAffine A).1
   325	        (overSpecTopAffine B).1 le_top)
   326	      = φ.comp (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k A).toAlgHom := by
   327	  have key : (Over.overSpecMap φ).left.appLE (overSpecTopAffine A).1
   328	        (overSpecTopAffine B).1 le_top ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).hom
   329	      = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).hom ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom := by
   330	    have h₁ : (Over.overSpecMap φ).left.appLE (overSpecTopAffine A).1
   331	          (overSpecTopAffine B).1 le_top
   332	        = (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)).appTop :=
   333	      Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _
   334	    rw [h₁]
   335	    exact Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)
   336	  ext x
   337	  exact congr($(key).hom x)
   338	
   339	/-- **Naturality of the widened affine comparison**: over affine tests, `divFamZarAff.map` along
   340	`Spec` of an algebra map corresponds to `DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom` of that map under the widened
   341	collapse `divFamZarAffAffineEquiv`.
   342	
   343	This is the coherence that carries the widened certificate lane's endpoint (which lands at an
   344	affine test) into the functor: the glued general-test restriction agrees with the widened total
   345	base change wherever both are defined. -/
   346	theorem divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_naturality (φ : A →ₐ[k] B)
   347	    (s : divFamZarAff C n (overSpec k A)) :

   349	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φ (divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C n A s) := by
   350	  rw [divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_apply, divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_apply, divFamZarAff.map_val]
   351	  have hval := divFamZarAff.mapVal_eq_mapAlgHom C n (Over.overSpecMap φ) s
   352	    (W := overSpecTopAffine B) (V := overSpecTopAffine A) le_top

   355	        (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.appLEAlgHom (Over.overSpecMap φ)
   356	          (overSpecTopAffine A).1 (overSpecTopAffine B).1 le_top)
   357	          (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine A)))
   358	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom ((Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k B).toAlgHom.comp
   359	          (Over.appLEAlgHom (Over.overSpecMap φ)
   360	            (overSpecTopAffine A).1 (overSpecTopAffine B).1 le_top))
   361	          (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine A)) := (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp _ _ _).symm

   363	          (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine A)) := by
